top_stories.title: Robinhood Chain outpaces Solana and BNB Chain in fees, driven by exchange stake purchases and rapid growth
points: Robinhood acquired ownership stakes in major crypto exchanges Crypto.com and OG.com, expanding beyond its retail trading app
Robinhood Chain generated $33 million in fees over a 15-day window, outpacing Solana (~$11M) and BNB Chain (~$9M)
Robinhood retains ~90% of collected fees on its income statement, with 10% going to Arbitrum (a scaling network) for infrastructure and under 1% to Ethereum for data availability

Since its July 1 launch, Robinhood Chain has reached $1.5B in total value locked (TVL, the amount of crypto assets deposited in a network's applications), $50+ billion in decentralized exchange (DEX) volume, and stablecoin supply grew from $241M to $1B
Tokenized stock holdings on the chain increased 14x to $140M, spanning both DeFi (decentralized finance) and real-world asset (RWA) tokenization
Bernstein projects ~$160M in annualized fees by 2028 and maintains an Outperform rating with a $160 price target (~31% upside) on Robinhood Markets stock

unique_angles.point: Frames the exchange stakes as part of a broader trend of traditional finance brokers pushing into crypto trading platforms to capture volume rather than compete indirectly
Provides detailed on-chain metrics for Robinhood Chain's growth and Bernstein's specific financial projections, treating the exchange stakes as background context rather than the main story

items.title: Visa's Stablecoin Settlement Volume Surges on Working-Capital Innovation
points: Visa's stablecoin (a cryptocurrency pegged to a stable asset like the US dollar) settlement volume hit a $20B annualized run rate, up 15x year-over-year
Payment volume across 160+ stablecoin-linked card programs rose nearly 200%
Credit Coop launched a stablecoin-denominated credit facility using smart contracts (self-executing code on a blockchain) to automate lending, cutting card issuers' borrowing costs by up to 30%
The facility addresses a working-capital gap: issuers must fund daily settlements before collecting from cardholders, so the loan is secured by settlement receivables
Rain financed roughly $2B through the facility with zero defaults since 2023; travel card issuer Karta, also using Credit Coop, separately raised $140M in June

items.title: Ethereum Foundation Sets December 2029 Deadline for Quantum-Safe Upgrade
points: The Ethereum Foundation set December 2029 as a firm, non-negotiable deadline for making its Layer 1 (the base blockchain network) resistant to quantum computer attacks that could break current encryption

The upcoming 'Hegotá' fork includes two required proposals: FOCIL (EIP-7805), which strengthens censorship resistance by letting a validator committee force-include valid transactions, and Frame Transactions (EIP-8141), which makes account abstraction (programmable wallet spending rules) a native feature by splitting transactions into programmable frames
The deadline can only be reassessed starting January 2030

The Foundation is explicitly planning for the possibility of 'Q-day' — the point when quantum computers could break current cryptography — arriving as early as 2030, treating the transition as an existential infrastructure priority

items.title: Crumbs Launches Stock-Token Shopping Rewards on Robinhood Chain
points: Crumbs launched a rewards program converting retail purchase receipts into tokenized equity, such as $COST tokens for Costco purchases
The program merges real-world asset (RWA) tokenization — representing physical or traditional financial assets as blockchain tokens — with traditional loyalty programs

items.title: Coldcard Hardware Wallet Thefts Escalate in Third Attack Wave
points: An attacker moved $7.7 million in Bitcoin, representing 45% of the BTC stolen during the third wave of a serial theft campaign
On-chain tracking confirmed the attacker fully drained all 11 of the largest vaults tied to this third wave
The campaign spans at least three documented waves, each followed by fund movements that have so far evaded interdiction
The incidents highlight ongoing security risks for hardware wallet (a physical device storing crypto private keys offline) users and the need for better custody practices and transaction monitoring

items.title: SEC Reportedly Preparing Tokenization Exemption
points: An unconfirmed report suggests the SEC is preparing an exemption allowing tokenized securities to trade through transfer agents alone, without broker-dealer licensing or exchange rule requirements
If approved, the exemption would remove regulatory friction for US retail and foreign investors trading tokenized securities, potentially accelerating real-world asset tokenization adoption

The investments mark Robinhood's latest move to expand its crypto presence beyond its existing retail trading app
Strategic stakes in major crypto exchanges position Robinhood to benefit from growing institutional and retail adoption of digital assets

sections.title: Robinhood's Crypto Exchange Investments
points: 1. Robinhood purchased ownership stakes (minority or majority share unknown from headline) in both Crypto.com, a major centralized exchange, and OG.com
2. This follows Robinhood's previous crypto expansion, including adding cryptocurrencies to its existing retail brokerage platform
3. The move reflects traditional brokers' strategy to capture cryptocurrency trading volume rather than compete indirectly
